test_cases.objective: Verify that the system accurately monitors temperature within the specified range of -80°C to +50°C with ±0.5°C accuracy.
prerequisites: System is installed and powered on

test_steps.action: Set up the temperature reference device to -80°C and place it in the monitored area.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays temperature reading within -80.5°C to -79.5°C.

test_steps.action: Set up the temperature reference device to +50°C and place it in the monitored area.
test_steps.expected_result: System displays temperature reading within +49.5°C to +50.5°C.

acceptance_criteria: All temperature readings must be within ±0.5°C of the reference device.
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for accurate data recording
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be stored in vendor's standard database format
required_expertise: Basic knowledge of temperature monitoring systems

test_cases.objective: Verify that the system correctly generates and sends alarm notifications to the site paging system when temperature deviates ±2°C from setpoint.

test_steps.action: Set the temperature setpoint to 25°C and configure alarm threshold to ±2°C.
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts the configuration without errors.

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature reading of 27.1°C (exceeding +2°C threshold).
test_steps.expected_result: System generates an alarm and sends notification to site paging system within 30 seconds.

acceptance_criteria: Alarm notifications must be received by the paging system within 30 seconds of threshold breach.
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for alarm generation
data_integrity_requirements: Alarm events must be recorded in the audit trail

test_cases.objective: Verify that the system accurately monitors temperature within the specified range of -80°C to +50°C with an accuracy of ±0.5°C.
prerequisites: System is installed and powered on
Test environment with controlled temperature conditions

test_steps.action: Set up the test environment to a known temperature within the specified range using a calibrated reference device.
test_steps.expected_result: Test environment stabilizes at the set temperature within ±0.1°C of the reference device.

test_steps.action: Record the temperature displayed by the EMS and compare it to the reference device.
test_steps.expected_result: EMS-reported temperature is within ±0.5°C of the reference temperature.

acceptance_criteria: All temperature readings must be within ±0.5°C of the reference device.
System must maintain accuracy across the full specified temperature range.
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for accurate data recording
data_integrity_requirements: All temperature data must be stored with timestamps and without modification.
Data must be retrievable for review and audit purposes.

test_cases.objective: Verify that the system correctly generates and sends alarm notifications to the site paging system when temperature deviations occur.
prerequisites: Test environment with controlled temperature conditions

test_steps.action: Set the temperature setpoint to a known value and configure the alarm threshold to ±2°C.
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts the setpoint and alarm threshold configuration.

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature deviation exceeding ±2°C from the setpoint.
test_steps.expected_result: System generates an alarm and sends a notification to the site paging system within 30 seconds.

acceptance_criteria: Alarm notifications must be generated and sent to the paging system within 30 seconds of the deviation.
All alarm events must be logged with timestamps for audit purposes.
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for alarm logging
GMP requirements for timely alarm notification
data_integrity_requirements: All alarm events must be logged with timestamps and without modification.
Alarm logs must be retrievable for review and audit purposes.

test_cases.objective: To verify that the system accurately monitors temperature within the specified range of -80°C to +50°C with an accuracy of ±0.5°C.

test_steps.action: Set the temperature sensor to a known value within the range.
test_steps.expected_result: The system displays the temperature within ±0.5°C of the set value.

acceptance_criteria: Temperature readings are within ±0.5°C of the set value
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be accurate and reliable

test_cases.objective: To validate that alarm notifications are correctly integrated with the site paging system using the vendor API.

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature deviation beyond the setpoint.
test_steps.expected_result: An alarm notification is sent to the site paging system via the vendor API.

acceptance_criteria: Alarm notifications are successfully sent to the paging system
data_integrity_requirements: Notifications must be timely and accurate

test_cases.objective: Verify that the system generates alerts when temperature deviates ±2°C from the setpoint.

test_steps.action: Set the temperature setpoint to 25°C in the system configuration.
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts the setpoint and displays it correctly.

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature reading of 27.5°C (exceeding +2°C deviation).
test_steps.expected_result: System generates an alert within 30 seconds.

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature reading of 22.5°C (exceeding -2°C deviation).
test_steps.expected_result: System generates an alert within 30 seconds.

acceptance_criteria: Alerts are generated within 30 seconds of temperature deviation
Alert messages include the correct temperature value and deviation
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records and alerts
data_integrity_requirements: Alert records must be stored in the vendor's standard database format

test_cases.objective: Verify that the system properly retains and archives data for the required 7-year period.

test_steps.action: Generate test data spanning multiple years in the system.
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts and stores all test data.

test_steps.action: Initiate the vendor's archival process for the test data.
test_steps.expected_result: System successfully archives data without corruption.

test_steps.action: Attempt to retrieve archived data from 7 years prior.
test_steps.expected_result: System successfully retrieves complete and accurate archived data.

acceptance_criteria: Data is successfully archived without loss or corruption
Archived data can be retrieved after 7 years
Data integrity is maintained throughout archival and retrieval
regulatory_basis: 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic record retention
data_integrity_requirements: Data must remain complete and accurate throughout archival
Audit trail must be maintained for all archival operations

test_cases.test_name: Temperature Alert Generation and Notification Test
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system generates alerts when temperature deviates ±2°C from setpoint and integrates with the paging system.
prerequisites: Paging system is configured and online

test_steps.action: Set a temperature setpoint of 5°C in the system configuration.
test_steps.expected_result: System accepts the setpoint and displays it correctly.

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature reading of 7.5°C (exceeding +2°C deviation).
test_steps.expected_result: System generates an alert within 30 seconds.

test_steps.action: Verify the alert is received by the paging system via the vendor API.
test_steps.expected_result: Paging system displays the alert notification correctly.

acceptance_criteria: Alerts are generated within 30 seconds of deviation
Alerts are correctly transmitted to the paging system
Alert content matches the expected format
data_integrity_requirements: Alert logs must be stored in the vendor database
Audit trail must record alert generation events

test_cases.test_name: Data Retention and Archival Verification Test
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system correctly archives and retains data for the required 7-year period.
prerequisites: System has been operational for at least 1 month

test_steps.action: Generate test data covering a 1-month period using the system's normal operation.
test_steps.expected_result: Data is stored in the vendor's standard database format.

test_steps.action: Initiate the archival process using the vendor's built-in functionality.
test_steps.expected_result: System successfully archives data without errors.

test_steps.action: Verify archived data can be retrieved and is complete.
test_steps.expected_result: All test data is retrievable and matches original records.

acceptance_criteria: Data is archived without loss or corruption
Archived data can be retrieved completely
data_integrity_requirements: Archived data must maintain original accuracy
No data modification during archival process
